content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it's possible to have the [product_name] automatically restart itself after a certain timer value. If so, how would I accomplish this? Alternatively, can the software be used to disconnect power from a physical input?

The [product_name] cannot restart itself directly from its program. However, you could design a program where a relay is activated after a set time (after restart), and use the normally closed contact of this relay to switch the power supply of the [product_name].

I'm sorry, but I didn't quite follow. If I have a sensor and a motor, I need the motor to restart after 30 seconds of the sensor running, and vice versa. Is this feasible? If so, could you provide an example?
That’s essentially what you described in your previous message...

Yes, but since you said restarting the [product_name] itself is not possible, I am seeking alternative solutions. If I can't restart the [product_name] entirely, is it possible to restart just the components connected to it?
At this point, I’m not sure what your exact requirement is...

Let me clarify. I have a sensor and a motor, and if either one operates for more than 30 seconds, I want to cut their power and then restore it automatically, essentially creating an automatic restart for the sensor or motor via programming.

Hi, Based on your description: Connect the power lines for the motor and the sensor to one or two relay outputs of the [product_name]. This way, you can programmatically interrupt and restore power as needed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing whether the [product_name] is capable of performing automatic restarts of itself or connected devices through program logic. Some confusion exists regarding the device's ability to reset itself, but it is confirmed that while self-restart isn't supported, relay outputs can be used to control and power cycle attached devices such as motors and sensors.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the [product_name] should allow for automatic self-restarts or at least programmatic power cycling of connected devices based on a timer or logic, aiming for a solution controlled by the device's programming.
